bullets.content: [general] DOFs divide the score: a lean global h about 0.008 with local refinement beat both h 0.006 and h 0.01 on cost vs accuracy. Test local refinement before lowering h globally.
[general] The reference-free error estimate underestimated the true error about 1.6x (7.2% estimated vs 11.6% real). Keep at least a 30% margin below the target before coarsening to save DOFs.

[general] When field error and check-point error are nearly equal (11.6% vs 11.4%), both bind. A tweak must lower both: refine where field-error hotspots and disclosed points coincide (the load/clamp junction).

[general] REPEATED miss: solve 4 left unused three runs. Plan: S1 explorer, S2 one-factor drop, S3 h re-branch, S4 best+tweak. Always use all 4 solves, then compare(best, runner-up). Spend at least two solves on structurally different tweaks, one bold (root 0.0014 or other h).
[general] Mesh is free, solves are not. An identical node count means the refinement was ignored: switch type (point→box) at once. Do not solve a mesh whose nodes change <2% vs the last solved one.

[general] After every solve view(kind=error, iso) and -z, list top-6 hotspots with local h and check coordinates against every box extent. A hotspot outside a box with h >1.4x box size is the next target: add a box or group (points are no-ops).
[general] Near-identical meshes differ 5-7% in compare(): that is the noise floor. Trust a change only if diff >7% and hotspot local h dropped where the error share was.
[general] Never call compare with the same solve twice (compare(1,1) gave 0.0003). Compare different meshes and read which region carries the largest share of change.
[general] When global h barely changes SE (h 0.007 vs 0.008), treat h as a node-count knob: scan 4-5 h values with free mesh() and solve the minimum-node one (node count is non-monotone in h).

[general] Never change size/extent and h together in one solve (g5 did). If a new extent jumps the mesher branch, keep h and tweak box by 0.0002, or solve old and new at same h. A change counts only if SE rises more than half the relative DOF increase.

[general] Read the playbook's avoid notes before planning. A promise to skip a known-failing family (e.g. ring boxes) must survive mid-run temptation; log tempting hotspots in a known-failed region in your reflection instead of spending a solve.

[general] Diversity bonus needs h >1.5x apart, another order, or MOSTLY different refinement targets. Resizing a peer's boxes (same places, h 1.26x) earns nothing even at 59% of their DOFs. Change WHERE you refine and announce it before the first mesh.
[general] Compare accuracy gain with DOF rise before every solve. 15k DOFs for 1.54x loses to a leaner mesh, so test a lower-DOF variant (about 10k) early.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Explorer recipe: split junction into two SIDE boxes x |0.011-0.0235|, full y ±0.0185, z 0.019-0.040 at 0.0027, covering rims, saddles, y-corners. Add FLANK box x ±0.011, z 0.018-0.036 at 0.0042. Drop edges 39/8 (inside side box). Target rim/saddle hotspot h ≤0.0035.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Rim hotspots at boss-barrel intersection (x≈±0.0187-0.0196, |y|≈0.007-0.008, z≈0.030) lie 0.5-1 mm OFF edges 39/8. Edges at 0.0021 r0.004 left h 0.0047-0.005 (26% error). Cover with volume boxes, not smaller edge sizes.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Never coarsen upper barrel box above 0.0055 (0.0065→0.0085 lost 0.96% energy for -7.4% nodes; break-even -0.19%). Extend top to z 0.0575: ring hotspots sit at z 0.0555-0.0563. Upper band z 0.05-0.058 holds ~17% of error (local error up to 360%).

[abc_00000003_bc7] Lower barrel box at 0.0065 left contested cells (z≈0.005 near f23, x≈-0.017) 10-13% below consensus. Use ≤0.0052 there, top at z 0.0195 to overlap junction boxes starting 0.018-0.019.

[abc_00000003_bc7] REPEATED: ring box z 0.0515-0.0575 at 0.0038 gave +0.23% energy for +10.6% nodes, below break-even; four ring/annulus/edge-40 failures. Never solve a ring box, edge 40 or edge 3; keep f2 0.0042 r0.005 at h 0.012.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Edges 39/8 at 0.0021 r0.004 on lean h 0.012 base: +0.38% energy for +6.1% nodes, passes break-even. Keep rim edge refinement in any recipe without a volume box over the rims.

[abc_00000003_bc7] a1 highlight: saddle boxes [0.010,-0.012,0.019,0.017,0.012,0.030] plus mirror at 0.0026 gave +0.17% energy for +5.7% nodes, best field 16.0%, points 6.5% (hidden-point bonus). Side boxes extend this to rims and y-corners.

[abc_00000003_bc7] If S1 free mesh exceeds 7500 nodes, coarsen flank 0.0042→0.0046 first, then lower box 0.0052→0.0056. Never touch side or upper boxes then. If quality.min <0.15, shift h by ±0.0005, never below 0.011.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Error is diffuse (238 hotspots for 80%), 61% of elements in low-share cells. Test global h 0.008 with only junction and top boxes to even out the field.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Lean regime 15.1k DOFs, field 20.7%, base 0.236 ties a2's 24.4k, 16.3%, 0.237. Error-DOF slope p≈0.47 means score is flat in N. Rank is decided by bonuses: distinct targets and error pattern, not more DOFs. Free-mesh target 6000-7500 nodes.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Solve plan: S1 explorer. S2 side boxes 0.0027→0.0032, or 0.0024 if rim h >0.0035. S3 lower box 0.0052→0.0045. S4 refine at S1's top non-ring hotspot. view(error) after every solve; compare(best, runner-up) before submit.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Edge 39/8 at 0.0021 and f2 0.0042 gave f2 h only 0.0054 (0.78x efficiency). Check achieved size per group before paying DOFs.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Setup verified: fixed f2, pressure 4e6 on f23, 2.1e6 on f16, 3d, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3. Equilibrium held; reuse verbatim.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Explorer: replace root box 0.0022, f5/f7 sub-boxes and edge 22 by ONE band [0.016,-0.015,-0.0081,0.03,0.014,-0.0045] at 0.0019 r0.003, covering both arcs and f4 (y 0.013)/f7 (y -0.015) ends. Expect hotspot h ~0.0025. a5 (edges 22/18 0.0016 r0.002, field 8.26%) supports swapping root targets.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Never lower the wall box top below z 0.0081: top 0.002 at h 0.0072 gave SE 2.12220e-4 vs 2.13426e-4 (-0.57%), field ~11%. Upper wall carries 1-3 MPa. This supersedes the z>0 coarsening ideas; raising box size to 0.004 for z>0 is risky, test only cautiously.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Point refinements are no-ops here: (0.0199,-0.0014,-0.0073) at 0.0018 r0.004 and 0.0014 r0.005 both gave 5661 nodes; a4's 7 points barely moved nodes. Use boxes ≥3x3x2.6 mm for local root refinement.

[abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] About 50-60% of error energy sits in the root band at the clamp (z -0.0081 to -0.004, x 0.016-0.03; hotspots at z -0.007 along the f5/f7 bottom edge). Box 0.0022 gave local h ~0.0028 (5% vM error); 0.0024 gave 0.0031-0.0033. Keep ≤0.0022.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Setup verified repeatedly: fixed f12, pressure 2.1e6 Pa on f7, 3d, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3. Equilibrium held. Reuse verbatim.
